title: OpenReading Leaderboard Report v0.1
description: The output of `evals.leaderboard.run_leaderboard` (BL-160): the SAME evals.dataset case.json corpus run through the unchanged evals.runner.run_case path across N registered backends, ranked by measured mean score on that one dataset. Backends are ranked best-first; each row carries its measured score, per-dimension breakdown, error tally, and cost basis together (never a rank without the price that produced it). `dataset` names the exact corpus that produced this ranking (path, case count, case names) so two reports are never structurally mistakable for having run the same cases. schema_version is a per-version const.

backends.description: One row per benchmarked backend, sorted best-first (rank 1 = highest mean_score).

cases.description: One row per dataset case, in dataset order, with every backend's score on that case and the per-case winner.

path.description: The dataset directory this report ran.

mean_score.description: DatasetReport.mean_overall on this dataset — errored/unscored cases excluded from both numerator and denominator, never folded in as a fabricated 0.0 (see n_cases/n_scored/errors for provenance).

n_scored.description: Of n_cases, how many carried a recognized `expected` dimension AND ran without error — mean_score is grounded in this subset only.

cost_per_doc.description: The descriptor-cost proxy (strategies.calibrate._descriptor_cost) — 0 for a fully-local backend.

non_deterministic.description: True when backend_id is a member of comparison.report._NON_DETERMINISTIC — mean_score is then a single labeled sample, never trusted as exactly reproducible run-to-run.

dimensions.description: Per-dimension mean (the scorers.score() headline value — a dict-shaped dimension's f1, else the plain float) over the cases that exercised that dimension. Never blended into one cross-dimension number.

winner.description: The backend_id with the highest score on this case (ties broken alphabetically); absent/null when no backend produced a real score.

scores.description: backend_id -> that backend's overall on this case; null when errored or unscored (never a fabricated 0.0).
